business_membership_staff_identity_check.name: business_membership_staff_identity_check
business_membership_staff_identity_check.value: "core"."business_membership"."role" <> 'staff' or ("core"."business_membership"."handle" is not null and "core"."business_membership"."pin_hash" is not null)

loyalty_program_closing_window_check.name: loyalty_program_closing_window_check
loyalty_program_closing_window_check.value: ("core"."loyalty_program"."status" <> 'closing') OR ("core"."loyalty_program"."earning_ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."loyalty_program"."redemption_ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."loyalty_program"."earning_ends_at" < "core"."loyalty_program"."redemption_ends_at")

loyalty_program_card_gradient_pair_check.name: loyalty_program_card_gradient_pair_check
loyalty_program_card_gradient_pair_check.value: "core"."loyalty_program"."card_background_color_2" IS NULL OR ("core"."loyalty_program"."card_background_color" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."loyalty_program"."card_background_gradient_angle" IS NOT NULL)

loyalty_program_accrual_pair_check.name: loyalty_program_accrual_pair_check
loyalty_program_accrual_pair_check.value: ("core"."loyalty_program"."accrual_mode" = 'per_amount' AND "core"."loyalty_program"."accrual_block_amount" IS NOT NULL) OR ("core"."loyalty_program"."accrual_mode" = 'per_purchase' AND "core"."loyalty_program"."accrual_block_amount" IS NULL) OR "core"."loyalty_program"."accrual_mode" IS NULL

core_campaign_coupon_all_or_nothing_chec.name: core_campaign_coupon_all_or_nothing_check
core_campaign_coupon_all_or_nothing_chec.value: ("core"."campaign"."coupon_label" is null) = ("core"."campaign"."coupon_cost" is null) and ("core"."campaign"."coupon_label" is null) = ("core"."campaign"."coupon_max_redemptions" is null)
